nights.title: Pinhani
nights.name: Pinhani
nights.extract: Pinhâni is a Turkish alternative rock band. It was founded on 5 April 2004 by two cousins Sinan Kaynakçı and Zeynep Eylül Üçer as a modern rock band in Turkey. Pinhani have released several albums. Pinhani also made the soundtrack for the Turkish TV Series 'Kavak Yelleri'.

en.who: Pinhani is a turkish alternative rock band founded in 2004 by two cousins, Sinan Kaynakçı and Zeynep Eylül Üçer. The band has released several albums and made the soundtrack for the Turkish TV series 'Kavak Yelleri'.

facts: sie wurde am 5. april 2004 von den cousins Sinan Kaynakçı und Zeynep Eylül Üçer als moderne rockband in der türkei gegründet.

tr.who: Pinhani, 2004'te iki kuzen Sinan Kaynakçı ve Zeynep Eylül Üçer tarafından kurulan bir türk alternatif rock grubudur. Grup birkaç albüm yayımladı ve 'Kavak Yelleri' dizisinin müziklerini yaptı.

nights.title: Serdar Ortaç
nights.name: Serdar Ortaç
nights.extract:
Serdar Ortaç is a Turkish singer, songwriter and composer from Istanbul.
He is known as one of the most popular singers in Turkish pop-music history.
